title: Support access records still name the support team with the old ForgeAI name
what: When a gym owner lets support look for an hour, or support opens emergency access, the server writes who opened it as 'ForgeAI support' and the reason as 'The gym asked ForgeAI support to look'. These words go back to the admin app with the access record, so an owner can see the old product name instead of MettleUp. No later change on the server replaces them.
expected: Every word the server hands to an owner uses the MettleUp name.
how_often: every time support access is opened
fix_line: Change the stored support name and reason to say MettleUp, and update the old rows

items.reason: Data safety: the old gym summary table can still carry body weight, calories and protein to the gym (existing finding). Account deletion: a member still linked to a gym keeps the account and its summary while the app says all is deleted (existing finding). Billing: gym plans are paid by the gym outside the app and set only by HQ (0030), the member free-plan switch is unlocked by gym membership not payment, so no Play billing rule is broken here. No WhatsApp, SMS or ad sending lives in these files; Wear OS and ASCI do not apply to the database. The real Data safety form was not available to compare (Play report shows policy status clean).

The member cloud copy is built only for Google sign-in, so an iPhone app has no private sign-in choice Apple asks for (existing finding). In-app account deletion, which Apple also requires, exists on the server.

Exercise clips, music, voices, fonts, icons and licences are not stored in these files. Owner-uploaded product photos and gym logos sit in public buckets; the terms acceptance (0033) records the owner agreeing to the terms, whose wording on uploads was not in scope here. The old ForgeAI name is still handed to owners in support access records (new finding).
